sentences.translation: There are many rats in Hamelin.
The rats run into the houses.
The mayor calls everyone to the market.
In the morning, a strange man comes to town.
He wears colorful clothes and a flute.
He says, “I can catch the rats.
The man walks through the streets and plays beautiful music.
They run to the river and swim away.
But the mayor doesn't want to pay any money.
The next day he comes back.
They walk out of the city onto a mountain.
“ The mayor is writing new rules.
The baker gives bread to poor children.
The cobbler repairs shoes without taking much money.
A year later, new families come to Hamelin.
The children ask, “What is a flute?
The people of Hamelin still tell the story today.
They help each other and keep their word.
